summary: Practise principled field decisions, access logs and accountable response records. Explore this five-day humanitarian response course.
lede: Humanitarian response training helps response officers, programme coordinators and field team leads make and explain principled decisions when needs, access and information change. It develops skills in assessing evidence and prioritising needs, documenting access choices, and coordinating assistance while checking protection risks and recording community feedback for accountable follow-up.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who make, coordinate or document operational choices during humanitarian responses. It suits intermediate-level practitioners who need to connect field evidence with principled decisions and accountable follow-up.
modules: IASC Humanitarian Principles in Field Decisions
prerequisites: Intermediate-level work benefits from prior exposure to humanitarian, emergency, protection, programme or coordination operations. Bring experience reviewing field information or contributing to response decisions. Coding and programming are not required.
